decisions.context: The close model surfaced a genuine divergence with no ledger record: when a local close command is REJECTED, the port does not transition, while shipped Java WebSocketImpl.java:488-503 enters CLOSING. The port follows derive.go, its named fidelity authority.
decisions.decision: MATCH JAVA'S BEHAVIOR: change the port so a rejected local close follows shipped Java and enters CLOSING, then re-verify the full downstream chain (public corpus, live-oracle differential, Autobahn, formal close model, handshake exam). If re-verification shows the change would break a LIVE-CONFIRMED observable (i.e. live Java's own recorded behavior contradicts the source reading), STOP and surface that conflict to the owner rather than forcing the change. Whatever the outcome, the divergence and its resolution get a behavior-delta-ledger record.
